title: Joint Estimation of Abilities and Item Parameters for Large Language Models Using Probability and Binary Responses: A Fractional-Response IRT Framework
abstract: arXiv:2611.33493v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Large language model (LLM) evaluations provide two response types: probabilities assigned to correct answers and binary indicators of correctness. Restricting evaluation to one type narrows the range of available models or discards probability information. We propose a method to integrate both types through a common two-parameter logistic item response model and fractional-response quasi-maximum likelihood estimation. The framework includes binary-only models in common-scale evaluation without discarding available probabilityinformation; broader measurement coverage does not by itself ensure greater precision or measurement equivalence. Simulations evaluate statistical efficiency when both response types have the same expected value. Moreover, adding probability respondents improves item calibration more efficiently than adding binary respondents. translated_title: 基于概率与二值响应的大语言模型能力与题目参数联合估计：一种分数响应IRT框架
translated_abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）评估提供两种响应类型：赋予正确答案的概率值以及正确性的二值指示。仅限于单一类型的评估会缩小可用模型的范围或丢弃概率信息。我们提出一种方法，通过共同的双参数逻辑斯蒂项目反应模型和分数响应拟最大似然估计来整合这两种类型。该框架在共同量尺评估中纳入了仅使用二值响应的模型，同时不丢弃可用的概率信息；更广的测量覆盖本身并不能保证更高的精度或测量等价性。模拟研究评估了当两种响应类型具有相同期望值时的统计效率。此外，增加概率响应者比增加二值响应者能更高效地改进题目校准。然而，向已经足够精确的概率样本中加入噪声较大的二值响应可能会增加测量误差（摘要原文在此处截断）。
tldr: 该论文提出一种分数响应IRT框架，通过双参数逻辑斯蒂模型和拟最大似然估计，将大语言模型评估中的概率响应与二值响应统一整合进行能力与题目参数的联合估计，并发现概率响应者比二值响应者能更高效地改进题目校准。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a fractional-response IRT framework that jointly estimates LLM abilities and item parameters by integrating probability and binary responses through a common two-parameter logistic model with quasi-maximum likelihood estimation, finding that probability respondents improve item calibration more efficiently than binary respondents.
